title: Five required fields, the rest optional
decision: Required: schemaVersion, id, title, capabilities, decision. Optional: context, alternatives, consequences, revisitTriggers, $schema, originChange, supersededBy. schemaVersion becomes 2. The minItems constraints on consequences and revisitTriggers apply only when the field is present, so an empty array stays invalid while an absent field is fine.
context: The schema requires nine fields: schemaVersion, id, title, targets, context, decision, alternatives, consequences with at least one entry, and revisitTriggers with at least one entry. The playbook this repository follows says an ADR can be a single paragraph, that rejected alternatives are recorded only when they are worth remembering, and that consequences are recorded only when a non-obvious downstream effect needs calling out; it has no concept of a revisit trigger at all. Requiring all nine turns a one-paragraph decision into a form to fill in, and a required field that has nothing true to say gets filled with something untrue. That cost is paid at the moment a decision is being written down, which is exactly the moment where friction stops it from being written down at all.

alternatives.option: Keep all nine required and rely on reviewers to reject padding
alternatives.reason: A reviewer cannot tell a thin consequence from an honest one without re-deriving the decision, and the padding is already cheap to write.

alternatives.option: Drop revisitTriggers from the schema entirely
alternatives.reason: All 45 existing records carry one and several are load-bearing; making it optional keeps what is there without demanding it of the next record.

consequences: All 45 existing records stay valid, because every one of them fills every field; no data migration is needed for this decision, only for the flattening and the rename.
A record can now be a title, a capability and a paragraph, which is the shape most decisions actually have.
revisitTriggers: Records start appearing with a decision body that cannot be understood without a context nobody wrote.
